text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Heath Street East, between Mount Pleasant Road and Welland Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., on a street name basis. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Heath Street East to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only, on a street name basis, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd side of Heath Street East, between Mount Pleasant Road and Welland Avenue. 2. Authorized parking by permit only, on a street name basis, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the even side of Heath Street East, between Kingsmere Road and Welland Avenue.
